scripts_used: test_cigna_policy_detail.py (extended to capture the FULL Revision Details table per policy, not just the first 800 chars)
limitations: Covers only the 4 specific named pain-management coverage policies already targeted by test_cigna_policy_detail.py (0525, 0539, 0551, 0139), not a site-wide feed.

Each policy's own historical revision log only goes back as far as that policy's PDF documents (typically 3-5 dated revisions per policy, 2024-2026); this is the full real history available in the document, not an artificial cutoff.
revision_type is null where the row's leading label could not be confidently matched (e.g. 'Updated' or unlabeled rows); summary_of_changes is a verbatim excerpt capped at 500 characters.

This is a supplementary dataset to cigna_policy_updates_latest100.json, not a replacement; it was kept separate to avoid double-counting the same policy/date pairs that may also appear in the September 2026 monthly bulletin.
